headline: Weathered Expanse Battered by Relentless Assaults Across Devastated Frontline
war_summary: Combat in Weathered Expanse has escalated to fever pitch, recording fourteen strategic base transitions in the past two hours and pushing six positions into no-man's-land amid severe casualties around Wightwalk and Shattered Advance. Mooring County remains heavily contested, logging three additional base events over the two-hour span as Warden forces retain hold of all twelve positions despite ongoing pressure at Gravekeeper's Holdfast. Along the Nevish Line, combat has flared anew with nearly a thousand combined casualties and a fresh influx of eighty-two enlistments in the past two hours, though base lines held steady with Colonials clinging to two strongholds. Callahan's Passage sustained steady attritional fighting near The Crumbling Passage, yielding five hundred casualties over the latest two-hour interval. Meanwhile, casualty rates spiked sharply in Linn of Mercy with nearly three hundred Warden losses in the final hour. In contrast, the Dead Lands front has cooled substantially from its earlier tumult, and previously contested peripheral sectors such as Kuura Strand, Fisherman's Row, and Palantine Berm have stayed quiet.
